key_provisions.requirement: Applicable to establishments with 20+ employees. Employee contribution: 12% of basic wages. Employer contribution: 12%. EPF applies from day 1 of employment — probationers cannot be excluded.
policy_checklist: Policy must specify EPF from day 1 — no probation exclusion
Must state employee contribution as 12% of basic+DA
Must specify remittance by 15th of following month

key_provisions.requirement: Applicable to establishments with 10+ employees. Employee contribution: 0.75%. Employer contribution: 3.25%. Wage threshold: ₹21,000/month.
policy_checklist: Must state ESI wage threshold of ₹21,000/month
Must specify employee 0.75% and employer 3.25% contributions

key_provisions.requirement: Payable after 5 years continuous service. Formula: 15 days wages per year of service (not 10 days). Maximum: ₹20 lakhs. Must be paid within 30 days (not 90 days).
policy_checklist: Must specify gratuity formula as 15 days per year
Must state payable on resignation too

key_provisions.requirement: Paid maternity leave: 26 weeks for first two children (not 12 weeks). 12 weeks for third child. Nursing breaks: 2 per day until child is 15 months. Creche mandatory for 50+ employees.
policy_checklist: Must specify 26 weeks maternity leave for first two children
Establishments 50+ employees must specify creche provision
Must prohibit dismissal during maternity leave

key_provisions.requirement: Platform companies must contribute 1-2% of annual turnover to social security fund for gig workers. Gig workers must be registered.
policy_checklist: Platform companies must document gig worker classification
Must outline social security contributions for gig workers
